original.description: Portrait of Maximilian von Prittwitz und Gaffron, Generaloberst, by the Berlin portraitist Nicola Perscheid.
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"). Perscheid died in 1930, so the work is out of copyright on life + 70.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize only if a larger scan is found — 476 px is a person card at best.

caption: Maximilian von Prittwitz und Gaffron, commander of the German Eighth Army in East Prussia until Moltke relieved him on 22 August 1914 for proposing to fall back behind the Vistula.
credit: Original photograph: Nicola Perscheid, 1915; via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. The Commons record notes third-party claims over the digitisation but licenses the work itself as public domain; the underlying photograph is unambiguously out of copyright (Perscheid d. 1930).
